notes_for_editor: Two weak leads that may or may not be one structure: a USGS site record named Archer Fire Tower (site type Atmosphere; no continuous data listed) and a Pastmaps mention of an Archer Forestry Site Tower as a legacy site. The sources do not say whether the two refer to the same tower. The USGS point is about 37 m from the record's coordinates (our own calculation, not sourced). The Archer Historical Society site was read and does not mention the tower. Florida Forest Service records could settle the name and date.
